title: Operating-system command execution enabled in SQL Server in sql — review required
description: sp_configure xp_cmdshell turns the extended procedure back on, which lets any sufficiently privileged SQL caller run operating-system commands as the database service account. The database then becomes a pivot into the host. The rule flags the setting; whether the caller set is restricted is a review decision.
remediation: Leave xp_cmdshell disabled and move shell work to a job runner with its own identity and audit trail.
limitation: Lexical: matches the configuration statement; a server-wide setting changed outside SQL is out of scope.
